title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet now supports prompt caching
description: Prompt caching is now generally available on Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Haiku. You can cache up to 4 breakpoints per prompt, reducing costs by up to 90% and latency by up to 85% for long prompts.

title: Computer Use beta now available in the API
description: We've launched Computer Use in public beta. Developers can now direct Claude to interact with computer interfaces by capturing screenshots and issuing mouse/keyboard actions.
